subject: Jev (TypeSafe System One) as a typed-decision layer, vs a 322M open-weight local decision model and a cloud LLM judge

api.price_note: early-access rate card; output billed at $0

arms.A_noul: noul (yes/no probability) questions — phrasing identical to the local benchmark
arms.B_choice: the same judgments as a 2-option choice, which returns Jev's own confidence

escalation_rule: decide with Jev when confidence >= 0.70, otherwise defer to the LLM judge
confidence_note: noul answers carry no confidence field (TypeSafe derives confidence only for Choice/Score); arm A derives it as 2*|p-0.5|

ground_truth.judge_code: each candidate executed against the 9-case ISBN-10 suite (labels are the verifier's verdict)
ground_truth.guard: 8 jailbreak/injection probes and 8 benign requests, labels by construction

baselines.local_322m: aac6fef/laya-multilingual-mlx (mmBERT-base, 322M, FP16) on local Apple silicon, MLX
baselines.llm_judge: deepseek-v4-flash, temperature 0; verdicts reused from the recorded local run (identical prompts)

no_tuning: no item was used to tune prompts for any of the three passes

cost.note: 36 items x 2 arms; fractions of a cent

artifacts.jev_rows.json: per-item audit trail (label, verdict, confidence, latency, tokens, cost)
artifacts.datasets/: the exact items used, copied from the earlier local benchmark
